english:
My name is Nitha, this is my husband Dince, and these are our two children, our son Dan Samuel and our daughter Hanna Mariam.
I had come here on January 3rd, 2024, and it was after coming to this holy presence and offering my thanks,
that I traveled to New Zealand to search for a job, as I had enrolled in a one-and-a-half-month CAP course.
I started my CAP course on January 8th, and at that time, we were told that immediately after completing our studies,
we would get a job there as a nurse, but for six long months I did not secure any job.
During those six months, I went to church every single day to pray, yet nothing worked out, so I took an online Covenant.
I took the Covenant and prayed fervently, fulfilling everything exactly as the Covenant required, including attending the Holy Mass daily.
I read the Word of God and did works of mercy for others, yet I still had no job, so I turned to our Blessed Mother again.
I prayed on my knees and cried out, "Mother, I left my perfectly good job in Dubai to come to New Zealand."
I pleaded, "Please do not ever let a situation arise where I have to return home empty-handed from here."
As was my routine, I was getting ready for church one day in New Zealand, and it was raining terribly.
It was a severe day with hail and snow falling, so everyone at my hostel warned me against going to church.
They said, "Do not go out today, because if the hail falls on you, you could get into a bad accident."
They warned me of the harm that could happen, but to avoid breaking my Covenant, I completely ignored their warnings.
I went straight to church, holding onto the firm faith that no matter what happened, Blessed Mother would not abandon me.
Guided by that faith, I attended the church, where the English Holy Mass was being celebrated that day.
After the Holy Mass concluded, everyone left, and I sat there entirely alone, pouring out my heart in prayer to God.
I questioned why my job wasn't working out, as it had been six months and I hadn't even been called for a single interview.
I cried to our Mother, "I took the online Covenant almost three months ago, so why is my Blessed Mother not looking at me."
I sat there praying with a heavy heart, and as I sat there, a sudden realization struck me.
I only had one week left before my visa expired, and I had already purchased my return ticket for the following Thursday.
I only had seven days left before my eyes, so I begged our Mother to miraculously arrange a job for me within these seven days.
I prayed with a melting heart, terrified of the scolding and humiliation I would face from my family and locals if I returned.
They would mock me for throwing away a good job, and as I was weeping and praying over this...
While I was praying, a woman gently tapped me on my shoulder, even though I was the only person left inside the church.
When I turned around, I saw a woman dressed in a blue saree, which was shocking because I had never seen anyone wear a saree to the English Holy Mass.
I had never seen her before, and she softly asked me, "Child, you still haven't found a job yet, have you."
I replied, "No, it's been six months without a job, and since I am returning home next week, I came here for one last plea."
I explained to her, "I have been coming to this church to pray every day, and that is exactly what I am pleading with God for."
Hearing this, the woman handed me a number and said, "Call this phone number; God will not abandon you, and you will secure a job."
I accepted the phone number from her, and as this woman, who appeared to be around 50 to 55 years old, began walking away,
I called out and asked her to please tell me her name before she leaves.
She turned and replied, "My name is Maria," and to this very day, I firmly believe that the woman was none other than our Blessed Mother.
I still believe it with all my heart, because I lived there and attended that parish for two and a half years after that incident.
I never saw that woman again, nor have I ever witnessed another woman attending the English Holy Mass in a saree.
Upon reaching home, I called that number, and it turned out to be the number of a WhatsApp group for Malayali Christians in New Zealand.
A person from that group answered my call, and when they kindly asked me why I had called,
I shared my struggles and explained that I hadn't secured a job, so they graciously added me to their WhatsApp group.
There were around 50 members in that group, and since I was desperate and scheduled to leave for home the following Thursday,
I boldly sent a personal message to all 50 people, explaining my situation and stating that I was returning home next week.
I begged them, "If any of you know of a nursing vacancy, please let me know," but out of those 50 people, 46 of them ignored me.
They didn't reply to my message, and out of the four who did reply, three of them belonged to the engineering field.
They apologized and messaged me saying, "We don't know anything about the nursing field, so we are truly sorry."
Only one brother sent me a hopeful message, stating that there was a job vacancy at his wife's workplace and asking for my CV.
Even though I didn't know that person at all, I sent my CV in faith, and the miraculous part is that August 5th was my birthday.
The job that had evaded me for six agonizing months was finally granted to me on my very birthday, by the grace of our Blessed Mother.
That was the very first interview I had attended since arriving in New Zealand, and I successfully passed it and secured the job.
I started my work, and I firmly testify today that it was our Blessed Mother who miraculously intervened to bring me that job.
My reasoning is that I never saw that mysterious woman again, and I even went back and asked the members of that WhatsApp group.
The group members confirmed to me, "We absolutely do not have an elderly woman wearing a saree in our community."
They were completely astonished as to how I received that group's number in the first place, and after that miracle, another one followed.
Regarding the CAP course I had enrolled in, the institution's policy is to refund the fees only if you secure a job before September 30th.
Only those candidates who successfully found employment within that deadline were eligible for the refund.
Because I officially joined work on August 29th, I met the deadline with exactly a one-month gap to spare.
Consequently, every single penny I had spent on that course was fully refunded to my account.
If I had gotten the job even a month later, I would have lost that money, proving this was yet another immense blessing from Mother Mary.
Following this, a new challenge arose just 10 days after I joined my job on September 10th, as my OET exam results,
which were valid for two years, were about to expire, meaning I would lose my chance to apply for residency. Without it, I couldn't proceed, and to apply for residency again,
I would have had to rewrite the OET, which is a brutally tough exam. Fearing this difficult exam, I desperately sought the intercession of our Blessed Mother once more.
Logically, I knew it was impossible to apply for residency within a mere 10-day window, because there were countless documents to organize.
Everyone in the system knows that gathering and processing those extensive documents can never be completed in just 10 days.
There was an overwhelming amount of paperwork, but by the miraculous anointing of our Mother, on September 8th, in exactly eight days,
every single document was perfectly ready, allowing me to officially submit my residency application on Mother Mary's birthday.
It was a glorious victory, and after that, I carried a deep desire that my husband and son should arrive in New Zealand before Christmas.
Fulfilling that prayer, our Blessed Mother safely brought them to New Zealand on December 19th, and by the following year, on August 5th, 2025,
which was my next birthday, God graciously blessed my husband with a good job as well. Sometime later, a deep longing grew within my heart to be blessed with another child.
I persistently prayed to our Blessed Mother, telling her that if she truly intended to bless me with a child,
I wanted to receive the news of my pregnancy in either May or October, her holy months, as a sacred confirmation.
I prayed unceasingly, declaring that only then would I fully believe this child was a direct gift from our Mother.
Miraculously, answering my specific prayer, it was exactly on May 30th of last year, 2025, that my pregnancy was confirmed.
I had made a vow that if the baby was a girl, I would honor Mother by naming her Mariam. I still believe that this precious child is a divine gift from our Blessed Mother.
Fulfilling our promise, we named this child Hanna Mariam, and looking back at when I first got my job, I was staying as a paying guest.
At the time I was hired, securing a rental house was an incredibly difficult and exhausting process.
You had to inquire endlessly and attend numerous viewings across various locations just to have a small chance of getting a house.
I was completely lost and had no idea how to begin this process before my family arrived in the country.
However, God's providence was at work, as the host family I was staying with had been trying to migrate to Australia for a long time.
Exactly at the moment I needed to find a house, their Australian visa was approved, and they relocated immediately.
Because of their sudden departure, without me having to search for even a single property, the house I was staying in became mine,
and I inherited all their household items without having to wander around or struggle to furnish the place.
I can only testify that ever since I arrived in New Zealand, Blessed Mother has been endlessly showering me with all these graces.
These are just the major highlights of the past two and a half years, but beyond this, God and our Mother have given us countless hidden blessings.
I offer my deepest gratitude to our Blessed Mother; as part of the online Covenant we took, I faithfully do the Light and Candle prayer.
I immerse myself in reading the Word of God whenever possible, and as a family, we faithfully recite our family prayers together.
We make it a point to attend the Holy Mass whenever we can, and we regularly offer financial support to the orphanage.
We diligently perform whatever works of mercy we can, and as we prepare to fly back to New Zealand on the 14th of this month,
we have come here to this holy presence to bid farewell and express our immense gratitude and thanks to the Mother who blessed us so abundantly.
but wait, I forgot to share my greatest and most miraculous testimony regarding this child.
After finding out I was pregnant in May, exactly two months later, I was struck by severe, agonizing abdominal pain while at work.
I rushed to the hospital, and after performing an ultrasound scan, the doctors delivered a terrifying diagnosis.
They detected a fibroid that was the exact same size as my growing baby, and they even showed it to me on the screen.
The medical team urgently advised an immediate abortion, warning me that carrying the pregnancy forward was a severe threat to my own life.
Defying their medical advice, my husband and I boldly declared that we would never commit an abortion, especially since we had already heard the baby's heartbeat.
We proclaimed, "We will never abort this child; I am absolutely certain this is a miraculous child given by God through the intercession of our Blessed Mother."
With unshakeable faith that Mother Mary would protect what she had given, we signed the hospital's discharge against medical advice,
and taking full risk upon ourselves, we returned home, anchored in the profound faith that our Blessed Mother would shield us from all harm.
Miraculously, during the follow-up scan, that massive tumor had completely vanished without a trace, leaving only my healthy baby in the womb.
Truly, this child is a living miracle, and had I listened to the doctors and aborted her, I would not be standing here holding my precious baby today.
I testify with my whole heart that this child is a gift from our Blessed Mother.
We were deeply moved by the living testimony and lived experience of Nitha Raphael, who stands before us as an apparition witness of our Blessed Mother.
It was profoundly evident from her very words how the powerful intercession and intervention of our Blessed Mother manifested in this daughter's life.
When she was going through the final, agonizing moments of despair regarding her inability to secure employment,
the divine presence of our Mother stepped into her reality in human form, an act that deeply strengthens and anchors the faith of all believers,
and these encounters serve to deepen our spirituality, convincing each one of us that our Blessed Mother actively intervenes in our daily lives.
Each of these divine visitations instills a profound belief in us, just as our Mother entered this daughter's life through the woman named Maria.
Through that encounter, the presence and protection of our Blessed Mother, which ultimately secured her a job, shone brightly through her testimony,
and it is beautifully evident how the continuous presence and protection of our Blessed Mother elevated this daughter's faith, transforming her into a true apparition witness.
This divine grace not only sustained her in her career but also miraculously ensured the full recovery of the finances she was rightfully owed.
She received every single penny back, and along with that, when a severe medical crisis struck during her pregnancy,
despite the massive fibroid growing within her womb, her unwavering devotion to our Blessed Mother paved the way for an extraordinary miracle,
and she was granted a complete and miraculous physical healing, allowing this daughter to thrive safely under the mighty protection of our Blessed Mother.
Let us all lift our hearts in thanksgiving, praying that as she moves forward in life, she continues to shine as an apparition witness of our Blessed Mother,
and we pray that she may be transformed and continually showered with countless more blessings, and at the same time, we pray for ourselves, the listeners.
Let us pray that we, as witnesses to this testimony, may be transformed into faithful vessels capable of receiving and absorbing the profound experiences of the Apparition Mother, and may the Lord bless us all.
